resources.string: Android 13 or later may block Accessibility after an APK install. Open these settings pages in order; each button unlocks the next step.
Open Installed apps, then SubHub. If it is greyed out, tap it once and dismiss the restricted-setting message.
Open SubHub’s app settings. Tap the three-dot menu, then Allow restricted settings. Confirm with your device PIN or fingerprint if Android asks.
Return to Accessibility → Installed apps → SubHub. Turn on the service and review Android’s access prompt before choosing Allow.
Some phones call Installed apps Downloaded apps. If Allow restricted settings is missing, try step 1 again. Return to SubHub and allow any remaining permissions.
Open Android Settings manually: Accessibility, or Apps → SubHub.
